description: Two hunched, pale-brown hominins with heavy brows and dark hair sit at the mouth of a rocky cave under a grey sky. The nearer one holds a small stone flake, cutting into a dark animal carcass with visible raw red meat. Scattered bones, stone flakes and pebbles lie on the cave floor, and a wooded hillside with pine trees is visible outside. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text or frame.
